evals.prompt: Mark opencode/step-5-preview-free unavailable in my Ensemble configuration. Preserve all costs, beta, custom models and pool settings.
evals.expected_output: Only availability changes; sources and representative routes reported; unrelated settings and custom entries preserved.

evals.prompt: Refresh the catalogue from a table with AA costs for most models and only CursorBench costs for one new model. Keep medium and high efforts as separate candidates.
evals.expected_output: Does not mix incomparable costs or turn missing cost into zero; preserves both efforts; proposes a minimal diff and requests approval.

evals.prompt: Our provider listing no longer contains one of my custom models. Update the catalogue without deleting my customization or changing review rules.
evals.expected_output: Reports uncertain availability rather than deleting or inventing IDs/efforts; preserves review policy and requests approval for a sourced refresh.

evals.prompt: Refresh my Ensemble catalogue. lastEvaluatedAt is 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z and lastSyncedAt is 2026-09-05T00:00:00Z. Two models are active, one is disabled, and a promising model released on September 20 is now listed by my configured provider.
evals.expected_output: Refreshes the two active models only; uses September 5 as discovery cutoff with dated web evidence; considers the new model and asks explicit activation permission; leaves the disabled model and active routing unchanged before approval.

evals.prompt: Refresh my catalogue, but there is no maintenance journal. The seed file was imported yesterday. Can you use that as the last evaluation date?
evals.expected_output: Does not treat import time as evaluation; asks a baseline or labels a first inventory; does not invent historical coverage or activate discovered candidates automatically.

evals.prompt: Last sync was October 1. One provider's release notes are unavailable. I approve the active-model price updates but not the recommended new model. There is also a pending newcomer from September 20 and an older declined proposal.
evals.expected_output: Applies only approved active-model data; does not activate the recommended/pending/declined models; retains partial-coverage warnings and pending decisions; does not advance success timestamps or lose pending candidates behind the next cutoff.
